high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a selfie indoors. The individual is wearing a teal-colored shirt with the collar open, revealing some chest hair. A pair of sunglasses is hanging from the shirt's pocket. The person has short dark hair and is wearing black ear gauges on both ears. The background features a wooden staircase with a polished finish and a railing that appears to be made of the same material. There is a white wall behind the person, and part of a framed picture or sign is visible on the wall to the right side of the image.
